english_title: Recognising and Responding to Asking for Water
vietnamese_title: Giao tiếp nền tảng: food & drink — asking for water
primary_communication_goal: recognise and respond to asking for water; complete the exchange naturally at A0 / Pre-A1.
context_note_en: Ms Lan is thirsty and asks Ms Olivia for some water.
context_note_vi: Chị Lan khát nước và xin chị Olivia một ít nước.

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: Excuse me, Olivia. Can I have some water, please?
turns.vietnamese: Xin lỗi chị Olivia. Chị cho tôi xin ít nước được không?
